### Hawaii Vacation Packing List

#### Clothing
- Lightweight swimwear
- Quick-dry beach cover-up
- Breathable shorts and t-shirts
- Light jacket for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Water shoes for snorkeling
- Sun hat and sunglasses

#### Gear
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach towel
- Snorkel and mask
- Sunscreen with high SPF
- Insect repellent
- Travel adapter
- Portable charger

#### Documents
- Passport and travel insurance
- Hotel confirmation
- Flight tickets
- Emergency contact list

#### Miscellaneous
- Travel journal
- Camera or GoPro
- Snacks and energy bars
- First-aid kit
- Cash and credit cards
